svg.title: What the metro and the VLT add to the people within an hour by public transport, Recife metropolitan region
svg.desc: On the left, a map of the west and south of the conurbation of Recife with the metro and VLT lines and the integrated terminals, and the cells of a grid coloured by how many more residents of the region they reach within an hour by public transport with the rail lines than with buses alone: the gain follows the lines, to Camaragibe and Jaboatão in the west and to Cajueiro Seco in the south. On the right, bars of the same gain for the average resident of each municipality: 22% in Camaragibe, 15% in Jaboatão dos Guararapes, 5.9% in Recife, and none in the municipalities of the north. The average resident of the region reaches 590,000 people with rail and 557,345 without.

g.text: More people within an hour with the rail lines,
Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Geofabrik extract of 2026-11-01. Timetables: Grande Recife Consórcio de Transporte
Metropolitano, GTFS v2026.10.26. Boundaries and population: IBGE, Censo 2022.
Residents of the region within an hour by public transport from each cell, with the rail lines over buses
alone (mode = c("WALK", "BUS"): the same bus timetables); departures 07:00–07:59 on Tuesday 10 November
2026. The average resident reaches 590,000 people with rail and 557,345 without, 5.9% more; 15% of
residents reach at least 10% more. Circles: integrated terminals
What the metro and the VLT add
